name: Valet Shoe Drop AI: Step Out of the Convertible Into the Hotel
blurb: The valet shoe drop is a 15-second old money arrival clip: a valet opens a peach convertible, the passenger drops her heels on the pavement, steps into them, puts on a white blazer and walks into a luxury hotel.
